   .. py:method:: forward(sample: torch.Tensor, timesteps: torch.Tensor, global_cond: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor

      Predict the denoising velocity for ``sample`` given the conditions.

      :param sample: Noisy action trajectory ``(B, T, C)``.
      :param timesteps: Diffusion timestep indices ``(B,)``.
      :param global_cond: Conditioning tensor ``(B, cond_dim)`` from the encoder.

      :returns: Predicted noise tensor matching the shape of ``sample``.
